name: paperbase-tools
description: Research tooling for Claude Code: build durable, evidence-grounded knowledge bases from directories of scientific papers.

plugins.name: evidence-grounded
plugins.description: Output style for scientific work: cites only sources retrieved in-session, prefers a local paperbase knowledge base, flags unverified recall, and keeps data, inference and hypothesis distinct.

plugins.name: paperbase
plugins.description: Turn a directory of scientific papers into a durable, incrementally maintainable knowledge base optimized for AI-agent context. Self-installing, self-tuning, provenance-checked.

plugins.name: synctogit
plugins.description: Sync a local lab project to GitHub under the RechaviLab file policy. Prepares eligible changes, offers conversions for images/PDF/Word/Excel, gets explicit approval in one review, then commits, integrates collaborators' work, and pushes. Also handles repository creation, cloning, and undo.
